assessment: This article studies the cellular basis of the Yki ortholog using a unicellular organism Capsaspora owczarzaki, given the unique position of this organism during evolution. The distinct roles they found for coYki are different from its role in metazoans, which have more to do with regulating cytoskeleton instead of promoting proliferation. The tools they developed could also be useful for other people to use this unicellular organism as a model.
